note: Hand-maintained. WDFW's rules for the nine report rivers, read on 2026-10-29 (sources and what was not confirmed: docs/research/2026-10-29-river-rules.md). scripts/build_river_rules.py turns this into river-rules.js. Source labels and links are deliberately not carried to the page.

rows.stretch: Mouth to 400 ft below the barrier dam
rows.text: Aug 1 to Dec 31: 6 salmon a day, no more than 3 adults (coho 20 in or longer). Only hatchery coho, which have a clipped adipose fin, may be kept.
Aug 1 to Dec 31: release all Chinook.

rows.stretch: Mill Creek to the barrier dam
rows.text: No fishing from a floating device. Night closure and anti-snagging rule through Nov 30.

rows.stretch: 400 ft below the barrier dam to the hatchery intake
rows.text: Closed waters.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Tongue Point line to the west end of Puget Island
rows.text: Through Oct 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 3 adults (coho 20 in or longer). Only hatchery coho, which have a clipped adipose fin, may be kept. (Set by WDFW's Sept 24 emergency rule.)

rows.stretch: Puget Island line to Beacon Rock
rows.text: Through Oct 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 2 adults. Only hatchery coho may be kept.

rows.stretch: Tongue Point line to Bonneville Dam, except the closed reach below
rows.text: Nov 1 to Dec 31: release all salmon other than hatchery coho.

rows.stretch: Tongue Point line to Bonneville Dam
rows.text: Release all Chinook through Dec 31.

rows.stretch: Beacon Rock to the Hamilton Island line
rows.text: Closed waters Nov 1 to Dec 31.

rows.stretch: Tongue Point line to Bonneville Dam
rows.text: Night closure. Barbless hooks required.

rows.stretch: At Bonneville Dam
rows.text: Closed waters from 600 ft below the powerhouse fish ladder to the upstream line of the dam, and inside the south navigation lock.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Mouth to Colvin Creek
rows.text: Oct 1 to Dec 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 3 adults, no more than 1 of them Chinook (coho 20 in or longer). Release all salmon other than Chinook and hatchery coho, which have a clipped adipose fin.

rows.stretch: Mouth to Colvin Creek
rows.text: Oct 1 to Dec 31: counts within the same adult limit, no more than 1 Chinook (Chinook 24 in or longer). Wild and hatchery Chinook may both be kept.

rows.stretch: Johnson Creek to Colvin Creek
rows.text: Night closure and anti-snagging rule through Nov 30.

rows.stretch: Power lines to Merwin Dam
rows.text: Closed waters.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Highway 14 bridge
rows.text: Oct 1 to 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 2 adults (coho 20 in or longer). Release wild coho, which have an unclipped adipose fin.

rows.stretch: Highway 14 bridge to 400 ft below the Shipherd Falls fish ladder
rows.text: Through Oct 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 2 adults. Release wild coho.

rows.stretch: Highway 14 bridge to 400 ft below the Shipherd Falls fish ladder
rows.text: Through Oct 31: release wild Chinook, which have an unclipped adipose fin.

rows.stretch: Mouth to 400 ft below the Shipherd Falls fish ladder
rows.text: Night closure for salmon and an anti-snagging rule through Oct 31.

rows.stretch: 400 ft below to 100 ft above the Shipherd Falls fish ladder
rows.text: Closed waters.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Mouth to Fisher Hill Bridge
rows.text: Aug 1 to Jan 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 2 adults in total across coho and Chinook (coho 20 in or longer, Chinook 24 in or longer).

rows.stretch: Mouth to Fisher Hill Bridge
rows.text: Night closure and anti-snagging rule through Jan 31.

rows.stretch: Fisher Hill Bridge to 400 ft above the Lyle Falls fishway
rows.text: Closed waters.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.
Aug 1 to Dec 31: 6 salmon a day, with no more than 1 adult in total, not 1 per species (coho 20 in or longer, Chinook 24 in or longer).
Closed from 6 p.m. Tuesdays to 6 p.m. Wednesdays during October.
Night closure through Oct 31. Anti-snagging rule through Dec 31.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Mouth to 1,400 ft below the Kalama Falls Hatchery fishway
rows.text: Aug 1 to Dec 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 3 adults (coho 20 in or longer). Only hatchery coho, which have a clipped adipose fin, may be kept.

rows.stretch: Mouth to 1,400 ft below the Kalama Falls Hatchery fishway
rows.text: Aug 1 to Dec 31: hatchery Chinook may be kept within the same limit. Release wild Chinook.

rows.stretch: Railroad bridge below I-5 to the Fallert Creek Hatchery intake
rows.text: Night closure and anti-snagging rule through Oct 31.

rows.stretch: Gas pipeline crossing to the Fallert Creek Hatchery intake
rows.text: Fly fishing only from Sept 1 to Oct 31. Barbed hooks are allowed.

rows.stretch: 1,400 ft below to 1,000 ft above the Kalama Falls Hatchery fishway
rows.text: Closed waters.

rows.stretch: Modrow Bridge down to about 1,000 ft below the temporary rack
rows.text: Closed waters while the rack is in the river.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Marblemount Bridge
rows.text: Through Oct 31: 2 coho a day, 12 in or longer.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Marblemount Bridge
rows.text: Through Oct 31: release all Chinook and every other salmon except coho.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Marblemount Bridge
rows.text: Bait is prohibited and single-point barbless hooks are required for salmon. Night closure.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Salmon Falls bridge
rows.text: Aug 1 to Dec 31: 6 salmon a day, up to 3 adults (coho 20 in or longer). Only hatchery coho, which have a clipped adipose fin, may be kept.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Salmon Falls bridge
rows.text: Aug 1 to Dec 31: no more than 2 of the 3 adults may be Chinook (Chinook 24 in or longer). Only hatchery Chinook may be kept.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Salmon Falls bridge
rows.text: Night closure from the mouth to the County Line ramp (the pamphlet gives no end date). Anti-snagging rule through Oct 31.

rows.stretch: Mouth to the Salmon Falls bridge
rows.text: Closed waters from 1,000 ft below to 200 ft above the temporary weir when it is in the river.

rows.stretch: Salmon Falls bridge upstream
rows.text: Closed waters.
Anglers 15 and older need the Columbia River Salmon and Steelhead Endorsement.
